### Auxiliary functions:

For modeling

```{r}
# To build the crossbasis object
build_crossbasis <- function(df) {
  # Extract exposure matrix
  expmat_tmean <- df %>%
    select(Tmeanw1:Tmeanw37)

  # Build crossbasis
  cb <- crossbasis(
    expmat_tmean,
    lag = 36,
    argvar = list(fun = "ns", knots=c(15,24)), #specify the placement of the knots
    arglag = list(fun = "ns", df = 3)
  )
}

# To calculate hazard ratios
calc_HRs <- function(df, cb, formula = NULL, cen = 16, at = 9:31) {
  model1 <- coxph(formula, data = df)
  crosspred1 <- crosspred(cb, model1, cen = cen, at = at)
  tmp <- data.frame(crosspred1$matRRfit) %>% 
    pivot_longer(names(data.frame(crosspred1$matRRfit)), names_to = "lag", values_to = "HR")
  tmp$HR
}
```

For plotting

```{r}
# To plot weekly associations
weekly_HR_plot_sim <- function(HRs_list, title = NULL, min_y = 0.9, max_y = 1.1) {
  mat <- do.call(rbind, HRs_list)
  df <-  data.frame(Ta = rep(9:31, each = 37), 
                    ga_week = factor(rep(1:37, 23)))
  df$HR_mean <- colMeans(mat)
  df$HR_se <- apply(mat, 2, sd)

  df %>% 
    filter(ga_week %in% c(2:37)) %>% 
    ggplot(aes(x=Ta,y=HR_mean)) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 16, linewidth=0.2, linetype = 2, alpha = 0.5) + 
    geom_hline(yintercept = 1, linewidth=0.2, linetype = 2, alpha = 0.5) +
    geom_ribbon(aes(ymin=(HR_mean - HR_se), ymax=(HR_mean + HR_se)), alpha=0.2, 
                fill= "#7A2412") +
    geom_line(color="#7A2412") +
    scale_y_log10(breaks = c(min_y,1,max_y)) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = c(min_y, max_y)) +
    facet_wrap(~ga_week) +
    labs(x = "Temperature (°C)", 
         y = "Hazard Ratio (SE)",
         title = title) +
    theme_bw() +
    mytheme
}

# To plot both methods combined 
plot_all <- function(HR_lists, filename = "Output/weekly.png", 
                     min_y = 0.9, max_y = 1.1) {

# Plot weekly associations:
  plot_set_to_zero <- weekly_HR_plot_sim(HR_lists$HRs_list_set_to_zero, title = "A. Set-to-zero", min_y = min_y, max_y = max_y)
  
  plot_filling_zero <- weekly_HR_plot_sim(HR_lists$HRs_list_filling_zero, title = "B. Zero-filling", min_y = min_y, max_y = max_y)

  
# Both methods:   
  plot_all_weekly <- plot_set_to_zero + plot_filling_zero
  
  ggsave(filename = filename, plot_all_weekly, width = 30, height = 20, 
         units = "cm", device = 'png')
}
```

### Simulation basic function

```{r}

simulate_survival_empirical_hazard <- function(baseline_hazard_vec,
                                               start_day_vector,
                                               causal_amplitude = 0,
                                               temp37,
                                               temp36,
                                               temp35,
                                               temp34,
                                               temp33) {
  
  n <- length(start_day_vector)
  cohort <- data.frame(id = 1:n, start_day = start_day_vector)

  # Simulating a causal effect of temperature:
  causal_modifier <- function(temperature) {
    theta <-  temperature / (31*7)
    exp(causal_amplitude * theta)
  }

  # Simulate time to birth with temparature modulated hazard
  
# h_final is calculated by the hazard function h(t|d,temp) for birth at gestational age t (in days) at calendar day d (ranging between 1 and 365), and temp_n the average temperature during the nth week of gestation (n in 33 to 37) in degrees Celsius based on scenarios of differing causal effect of temperature.
# Start_day: last menstrual period (LMP) day (ranging between 1 and 365)
  
  simulate_one <- function(start_day, temp33, temp34, temp35, temp36, temp37) {
    for (t in 1:max_day) {
      h_base <- baseline_hazard_vec[t]
      if (t >= 36*7) {
      h_final <- h_base * causal_modifier(temp33) * causal_modifier(temp34) * causal_modifier(temp35) * causal_modifier(temp36) * causal_modifier(temp37)
    } else if (t >= 35*7) {
      h_final <- h_base * causal_modifier(temp33) * causal_modifier(temp34) * causal_modifier(temp35) * causal_modifier(temp36)
    } else if (t >= 34*7) {
      h_final <- h_base * causal_modifier(temp33) * causal_modifier(temp34) * causal_modifier(temp35)
    } else if (t >= 33*7) {
      h_final <- h_base * causal_modifier(temp33) * causal_modifier(temp34)
    } else if (t >= 32*7) {
      h_final <- h_base * causal_modifier(temp33)
    }
      else {
      h_final <- h_base
    } # If a randomly drawn uniform value is below the hazard of birth at gestational day t (h_final), birth is assumed to occur on that day. Otherwise, the simulation continues to the next follow-up day.
      if (runif(1) < h_final) return(t)
    }
    return(max_day)
  }

  cohort$time_to_birth_days <- mapply(simulate_one, 
                                    start_day = cohort$start_day, 
                                    temp33, temp34, temp35, temp36, temp37)

  cohort$gest_age_weeks <- cohort$time_to_birth_days / 7

  return(cohort)
}

```

### Simulation loop function

```{r}

simulate_n_iterations <- function(n_sim = 1, 
                                  sample_size = 13160, 
                                  causal_amplitude = 0) {
  
  set.seed(123)
  HRs_list_set_to_zero <- list()
  HRs_list_filling_zero <- list()
  
  for (i in 1:n_sim) {
    
# Randomly select n births from the original birth cohort
    df <- sample_n(births, size = sample_size, replace = FALSE) 
  
# Simulate the cohort 
    sim_cohort <- simulate_survival_empirical_hazard(
      baseline_hazard_vec = baseline_hazard_vec,
      start_day_vector = yday(df$LMP),
      causal_amplitude = causal_amplitude,
      temp37 = df$Tmeanw37,
      temp36 = df$Tmeanw36,
      temp35 = df$Tmeanw35,
      temp34 = df$Tmeanw34,
      temp33 = df$Tmeanw33
    )

# Use the simulated gestational age at birth (in weeks)
    df$gest_age_week <- sim_cohort$gest_age_weeks

##### Zero-filling method
    df1 <- df
       
# Fill the post-birth exposures with zero  
    for (j in 1:37) {
      df1[[paste0("Tmeanw", j)]][j > df1$gest_age_week +1] <- 0
    }

# Create time and event variables
    df1$time <- as.integer(df1$gest_age_week) + 1
    df1$event <- as.numeric(df1$gest_age_week < 37)
    df1$time[df1$time > 37] <- 37
       
# Build the cross-basis for the DLNM
    cb1 <- build_crossbasis(df1)     


##### Set-to-zero method    
        
# Prepare the long data set for the Cox model with time-dependent covariates  
    df2 <- df[rep(rownames(df), as.integer(df$gest_age_week) +1),]

# Setting start (T1) and stop (T2) points for each follow-up step  
    df2 <- df2 %>%
      mutate(T2 = rowid(BirthID),
             T1 = T2 - 1)

# Event is 1: if birth happened in that follow-up week; 0: otherwise
    df2$event <- ifelse(df2$T1 == as.integer(df2$gest_age_week), 1, 0)
    
# Removing the follow-up weeks where there is no risk of preterm birth
    df2 <- df2 %>% filter(T1 > 22 & T1 < 37)
    
# Set the exposures to zero in the exposure weeks after each follow-up week  
    for (j in 1:37) {
      df2[[paste0("Tmeanw", j)]][df2$T2 < j] <- 0
    }
    
# Build the cross-basis for the DLNM
    cb2 <- build_crossbasis(df2)
    
  
##### Calculating hazard ratios for each method:   
    
    HRs_list_filling_zero[[i]] <- calc_HRs(df1, cb1, Surv(time, event) ~ cb1 + cluster(MomID))
    
    HRs_list_set_to_zero[[i]] <- calc_HRs(df2, cb2, Surv(T1, T2, event) ~ cb2 + cluster(MomID))
    
  }
  
    HR_lists <- tibble(HRs_list_set_to_zero, HRs_list_filling_zero)
}

```

### Preparation for the simulation

```{r}
# Load the real birth cohort data
births <- readRDS("birth_cohort.rds")

# Gestational age at birth (in days)
births$real_gest_age_days <- round(births$gest_age_week * 7)
max_day <- max(births$real_gest_age_days)

# Birth counts by gestational day
births_per_day <- tabulate(births$real_gest_age_days, nbins = max_day)

# Reverse cumulative sum (N still pregnant before each day)
still_pregnant <- rev(cumsum(rev(births_per_day)))

# True hazard: births on day t / still pregnant at start of day t
baseline_hazard_vec <- births_per_day / still_pregnant
```

### Running the simulations

```{r}

n_sim <- 500 # number of iteration
sample_size <- 131600/10 # 10% of the cohort population

date()

# Scenario 1: No effect of temperature
HR_lists <- simulate_n_iterations(n_sim, sample_size, 
                                  causal_amplitude = 0)
saveRDS(HR_lists, "causal 0 iter 500 sample 13K.rds")

date()
```

### Plotting

```{r}
# Scenario 1: No effect of temperature
plot_all(readRDS("causal 0 iter 500 sample 13K.rds"), 
         filename = "causal 0 iter 500 sample 13K.png",
```
